_comment: Plan 044. The recorded camp-raid policy table for tests/e2e/stance-balance.spec.js's
@sweep fixture: 40 seeds x 3 camps at held = 4, hero parked and idle.
`winPct` is guarded against drift (BASELINE_DRIFT_PCT); `unresolved` is guarded
against its own budget (TIMEOUT_BUDGET_PCT) rather than against this record, so a
change that removes MORE deadlocks never has to re-record to pass.
`pairedVsIdle` is RECORDED, NOT ASSERTED. The McNemar margin's standard error at this
sample size is ~5.3 points, so no reading here resolves the sign of a 6-point
difference. It is written down so the next plan argues against a number with an error
bar instead of against two rounded integers.
To re-record: `npm run test:balance`, read the printed table, paste it here, and say in
the plan why the new number is the correct one. Never re-record to turn a run green.
RE-RECORDED BY PLAN 045, for two reasons stated in that plan and measured there:
* STALL_TERMINAL ends fights that could not reach themselves. Camp raid seed 7 / c1
used to run past 600 simulated seconds with 541 of them without a death; it now
resolves at 104s. Every policy's `unresolved` column is 0 where it was 4 / 1 / 0 / 7.
* The harness window went 95s -> 180s (RAID_WINDOW_S). At 95s it scored a raid that
legitimately takes 131s (seed 7 / c2) identically to one that never ends.
Movement against the Plan 042 record: idle 82 -> 84, chargeAll 78 -> 78, split 76 -> 76,
holdLine 71 -> 77. holdLine moved most because it deadlocked most.
holdLine joined the sweep in Plan 045 (slice D1): it is the slowest policy and the first
to deadlock, and the sweep had never run it.
